mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `cors`.`users`(`name`,`store_name`,`business_num`,`usertype`,`email`,`password`,`phone`,`style`,`address`,`address_detail`,`gender`,`last_logout_at`,`created_at`,`social_type_code`,`social_id`) VALUES (#{register.name}, #{register.storeName}, #{register.businessNum}, #{register.usertype}, #{register.email}, #{register.password}, #{register.phone}, #{register.style}, #{register.address}, #{register.addressDetail}, #{register.gender}, IFNULL(#{register.lastLogOutAt}, NOW()), IFNULL(#{register.createdAt}, NOW()), #{register.socialTypeCode}, #{register.socialId})
mapper.select: SELECT `name` AS `name` , `store_name` AS `storeName` , `business_num` AS `businessNum` , `usertype` AS `usertype` , `email` AS `email` , `password` AS `password` , `phone` AS `phone` , `style` AS `style` , `address` AS `address` , `address_detail` AS `addressDetail` , `gender` AS `gender` FROM `cors`.`users` WHERE email = #{email} AND password = #{password} LIMIT 1;

SELECT `name` AS `name` , `store_name` AS `storeName` , `business_num` AS `businessNum` , `usertype` AS `usertype` , `email` AS `email` , `password` AS `password` , `phone` AS `phone` , `style` AS `style` , `address` AS `address` , `address_detail` AS `addressDetail` , `gender` AS `gender` , `owner_email` AS `ownerEmail` , `created_at` AS `createdAt` , `level` AS `level` , `last_logout_at` AS `lastLogOutAt` FROM `cors`.`users` WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1;

SELECT `name` AS `name` , `store_name` AS `storeName` , `business_num` AS `businessNum` , `usertype` AS `usertype` , `email` AS `email` , `password` AS `password` , `phone` AS `phone` , `style` AS `style` , `address` AS `address` , `address_detail` AS `addressDetail` , `gender` AS `gender` , `owner_email` AS `ownerEmail` , `created_at` AS `createdAt` , `level` AS `level` , `last_logout_at` AS `lastLogOutAt` , `social_id` AS `socialId` , `social_type_code` AS `socialTypeCode` FROM `cors`.`users` WHERE `social_id` = #{socialId} AND `social_type_code` = #{socialTypeCode} LIMIT 1;
